title: How can I contribute to my child's progress in therapy?
metaTitle: Parent's Role in Child's Therapy Journey | Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: Parents play a vital part in the child's therapy journey. Discover how you can contribute to progress by practicing skills, engaging in communication with therapists, and providing support.
html: Surely, your role as a parent is pivotal in the progress of your child's therapy. At Pinnacle Blooms Network, we value parental involvement. Practice the skills at home that your child works on during therapy sessions. You are also encouraged to have regular communication with the therapists for a deeper understanding of the progress. And of course, your patience, motivation and ongoing support go a long way in your child's therapeutic journey.
